bio.text: Eli Savit is the Democratic nominee for Michigan attorney general in the November 2026 election; he was chosen at the Michigan Democratic Party convention on April 19, 2026.
He is the Washtenaw County prosecutor and previously worked as senior legal counsel for the City of Detroit.

According to his campaign website, he was born and raised in Ann Arbor, attended Kalamazoo College and the University of Michigan Law School, and clerked for U.S. Supreme Court Justices Sandra Day O'Connor and Ruth Bader Ginsburg.

sources.title: Michigan Democrats choose Lt. Gov. Gilchrist as secretary of state nominee, Eli Savit for AG
